what_this_is: The qualification record for the freeze gate of a possible future bounded-discovery study: which probes in the proposed specification's catalogue were run, what each established, and which of #199's ten requirements are therefore met on the runtime and the targets a study would actually dispatch with. It is not a freeze, it authorizes no dispatch, and a status of not-ready is the finding rather than a placeholder.

P08.evidence: probes/P08b-bounded-allowance/; the first attempt is retained at probes/P08a-bounded-allowance-self-limited/

P16.why: host absence is unreachable on this host and the container regime cannot authenticate a session, so no isolation regime is established for a cell that must run a model session

P17.partial: the per-arm comparison against frozen allowances has no arms and no frozen allowances to compare

P18.why: per-role totals reconcile on all 28 metered sessions across primary, finder and verifier, but no provider error occurred, so the filtered-copy path is exercised by synthetic tests only

P20.why: the audit's refusal and its absence of an acceptance path are established on real transcripts, but P20 requires every permitted root - including D3's scratch allowance - frozen identically across arms first, and there are no frozen roots

P22.note: synthetic scale; the one shape correlation found was ruled on to let the probe complete and must be decided properly by a freeze

P24.evidence: probes/P24-fresh-targets/, targets/reservations.json (written by probes/P24-fresh-targets/reservations/), targets/eligibility-machinery-check.json (written by probes/P24-fresh-targets/machinery/)
P24.why: no target was selected. The reservation set and the mechanical criteria are delivered; the selection, adjudication, sealing and selector runs are not

P25.evidence: probes/P25-ledger-stop/ and this ledger's own terminal stop

P26.why: one of the chain's three links holds, and only for half the prompts. Comparing the whole pinned block rather than its opening, 9 of the 18 rendered prompts carry it - the nine rendered from the committed revision 2. The other nine are superseded attempts rendered from revision 1, which was revised before it was ever committed, so they tie to no pinned template. Link two does not hold: the prompts name their input by relative path and not by digest, and two normalised shapes each stand for three different packets. The third link needs a public cell summary and no cell ran

gap-1.requirement: Retain the launch argv per attempt
gap-1.what_holds: all 64 launches in this bundle retained their exact argv and requested model, effort, dollar allowance, restriction flag, tool list and allow list, written with O_EXCL and fsynced before process creation; one launch that never started kept its record. Metering checks each root transcript against the model and effort its own launch record requested: 28 observed and matching, no mismatch, and one - the cancelled P07 - passing vacuously because its transcript carries no assistant line, which its record says in as many words. Every committed report a verdict cites - freshness, reconciliation, retention, the frozen-input chain, the reservation set and the eligibility record - comes from a retained launch whose output matches it
gap-1.what_does_not: there are no arms and no frozen allowances, so 'every arm received identical allowances' has nothing to compare against

gap-2.requirement: Meter per role at settlement, never from unresolved filtered copies
gap-2.what_holds: per-role totals reconcile exactly to the recomputed charge on all 28 metered sessions across primary, finder and verifier; no session was left unassigned or defaulted to primary
gap-2.what_does_not: no provider error occurred, so the filtered-copy resolution path is untested against a real one; and the open question U5 stands, since every verifier session is metered as 'worker' with no initial/follow-up ordinal

gap-3.requirement: Write ledger lifecycle events when they happen
gap-3.what_holds: seventeen claims on a real ledger through a claim-before-launch path; eight refused, each naming its own rule, and the absence of a started worker asserted from the filesystem

gap-4.what_holds: on real transcripts, four out-of-root reads failed the audit, and offering a settlement acceptance for them changed nothing - both acceptances were recorded as ignored; a session that stayed inside its root passed
gap-4.what_does_not: D3 is undecided and no permitted root is frozen. P20 requires every root, scratch included, frozen identically across arms before probing

gap-5.requirement: Stop-gate probes must complete and sweep the real roots
gap-5.what_holds: the root was recorded while it existed, pinned outside the seal, and all eleven gate checks completed and established their conditions over that root and this study's own stopped ledger; authorize then accepted the gate
gap-5.carried_forward: the default two-letter container prefix produced two false process matches and must be replaced by a distinctive one in any freeze

gap-6.what_holds: nine payloads - findings, clean and stopped in each of three arms - accepted under one seven-key contract from a dispatch block byte-identical across arms, and uniformity refused to let masking proceed until the one real shape correlation was ruled on
gap-6.what_does_not: the block has never been rendered against a real target, and the correlation it found (items[].fix in one arm only) was ruled acceptable to let the probe finish rather than decided

gap-7.what_holds: with no judgments, all three of the egress probe's commands were refused; with judgments, the forge request was accepted by binding it to the proxy event that refused it, the environment read was accepted as no-traffic, and the raw socket - which connected and left no proxy event - could not be accepted at all; a session whose commands were local passed the same audit
gap-7.carried_forward: the audit checks that a bound event index is inside the log, not that the event corresponds to the command, so a judgment can cite the wrong event and pass

gap-8.what_holds: the extended reservation set is derived by rule from the ten files that publish it - 102 pull requests, from #148 section 7, #148's exclusion log, the sealed slot map, the four revealed slot registers, the two revealed excluded registers and 33 rows of the revealed inventory. 77 are evidenced by a backticked, linked or qualified citation; 25 are read conservatively from a bare number in running prose, which no rule separates from a citation of this project's own tickets, and are reserved rather than asserted because over-reserving costs a hunt one candidate while under-reserving costs the study its blind. E1, E2, E3 and E5 are implemented as a checker and exercised against the live forge, which excluded the four revealed targets by E1 and two of this repository's own pull requests by E2 and E3
gap-8.what_does_not: no target was selected, adjudicated, packeted, sealed or scope-selected

gap-9.requirement: Re-probe every runtime control before freezing
gap-9.what_holds: sixteen of the seventeen group-A probes are established on Claude Code 2.1.269, including the one #153 flagged: under --restricted a Bash allow list does exist when --tools names Bash, so the frozen launch shape runs as written and D7's stop condition does not trigger
gap-9.what_does_not: P16. Host absence is unreachable and the container regime cannot authenticate a session, so no isolation regime is established. The specification's rule is that an unsupported or unobservable control stops the study

gap-10.what_holds: the terminal stop preserves outstanding reservations, retained uncertainty and the chain, still accepts settlement, attempt closure and protected closeout, and refuses a new review reservation, a new pre-freeze reservation, a new attempt and a second stop; this study's own ledger carries its terminal stop, and the shutdown gate read it

freeze_evidence_section_11.2_every_probe_completed: no - five of twenty-seven are unestablished
freeze_evidence_section_11.3_every_readiness_row_established: no - this record is the freeze's own, and five rows are not established

freeze_evidence_section_11.6_ledger_with_cap_freeze: no - this ledger carries pre-freeze spend and a terminal stop; no cap was frozen and no protected reserve was set, because no projection exists
freeze_evidence_section_11.7_roots_record: present for this qualification's own roots - probes/P21-shutdown-gate/roots-record.json - but not for any cell root
freeze_evidence_section_11.8_dispatch_template_per_arm: partial - a payload-contract block rendered identically per arm at synthetic scale, with findings, clean and stopped probed in each; not a study dispatch template against a real target, and it carries no digest of the input it was rendered against, which is why P26's second link does not hold
freeze_evidence_section_11.9_sealed_schedule: no - there is nothing to schedule
freeze_evidence_section_11.10_recorded_dispatch_authorization: no - and the session that produced this record explicitly withheld it

entry_condition.requirement: a recorded decision that a confirmation study is warranted at all
entry_condition.detail: #153 recommended none and nothing since has changed that. The authorization this qualification ran under covers target preparation and capability probes only and explicitly excludes the experimental grid, so it is not the entry condition and is not a dispatch authorization.
